title: bl_authority's backticked-class-name blanking also drops the only push or delete word of a gate that asks the operator to push or delete in backticks, so that gate is classed design and an agent answers it
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons blanks a backticked gate class name only in a text that holds two or more of them or the word class, so a gate that asks to push or delete with the word in backticks keeps its class while a gate that lists class names to say what a phrase expects stays unclassed by them

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_authority as b;t=chr(96);g={"id":"g1","question":"Should the worker " + t + "push" + t + " the branch to the main branch?","options":["yes","no"]};c=b.class_reasons({"touches":[],"title":"x"},g)[0];print(c);sys.exit(1 if c=="design" else 0)
